meta.description: Implement data quality validation with Great Expectations, dbt tests, and data contracts. Use when building data quality pipelines, implementing validation rules, or establishing data contracts.

copy.tagline: 自动验证数据质量,提前发现数据问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责数据管道,需要自动检查数据质量,避免坏数据流入下游。
copy.tagline_en: Catch data issues early with automated quality checks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run data pipelines and want automated quality checks to catch issues early.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你写数据质量校验：用 Great Expectations 建期望套件、跑检查点，并按表汇总通过/失败报告，可让流程在检查失败时报错中断。
howto.when: 当你要搭建数据质量管道、编写校验规则或建立跨团队数据契约时接管，也包括在 CI/CD 中自动执行校验。

say.text: 帮我设计团队间的数据契约，并补上 dbt 测试

howto.what_en: Claude writes data quality checks for you: it builds Great Expectations suites, runs checkpoints, and reports pass/fail per table, and can fail the pipeline when checks fail.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you are building data quality pipelines, writing validation rules, or establishing cross-team data contracts, including validation in CI/CD.

say_en.text: Build a Great Expectations suite for orders: order_id not null and unique
say_en.note: Generates the suite and runs validation

say_en.text: Run a data quality pipeline over orders, customers, products; fail on error
Design data contracts between teams and add dbt tests
